title: 가리켜
sp: K-Pop Hip-Hop track featuring a blend of soulful R&B vocal hooks and rhythmic rap verses. The track features a slow-tempo guitar solo with high-gain sustain and wide vibrato. A melodic glockenspiel motif enters every eight bars, playing a descending pentatonic scale. Soft shakers provide sixteenth-note subdivision. Reverb is applied to the vocals and piano to create a sense of space. The arrangement features a bright, nasal male vocal delivery in Korean. The track maintains a steady 113 BPM in the key of G minor.
lyrics:

title: 에코
sp: K-Pop and J-Pop fusion with high-energy bubblegum pop elements. K-Pop Hip-Hop track featuring a prominent funk-influenced electric bassline playing syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. Occasional synth stabs and subtle atmospheric pads appear in the background. The arrangement is minimalist, featuring only the acoustic guitar and a single vocal track without additional percussion or instrumentation. vocal ad-lib: '전부거든'. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. Key of G Major.

title: 어둠
sp: K-Indie, Bossa Nova. The structure alternates between delicate harp-led passages and fuller ensemble sections with driving acoustic guitar rhythms. A dark, atmospheric synth pad provides a background layer during transitions. The arrangement features a prominent solo cello playing a melancholic, legato melody over a steady electronic beat. male melodic vocals with light harmony. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the guitar and the vocal. Percussion consists of a dry, mid-tempo kick drum and a crisp snare on beats two and four, layered with a subtle shaker.
